claim_boundary: This is a certified finite exclusion of exactly 100 named base orbits from a 4,748,938-orbit census. It does not establish F_1(13,199,14)=empty, J(13,199)=empty, LRC(13), a density estimate, or a universal structural rule.

companion_decision.falsifier: Any CNF/direct-predicate disagreement, proof-instance hash mismatch, DRAT rejection, or checked SAT witness invalidates the corresponding exclusion.
companion_decision.next_action: New Cycle 12: cluster certified UNSAT cores, formulate base-orbit invariant templates, and test a small exact checker before any broad census.
companion_decision.recommendation: Complete rows 0/2 in live Cycle 11, seal, then open Cycle 12 for reusable checked core templates rather than a raw full census.
companion_decision.strongest_flaw: DRAT certifies CNF UNSAT only; a common encoding error must be excluded independently.

containment.effect_on_claim: None: the two proof files were preserved and later VERIFIED, and the complete corpus passed a fresh independent replay.
containment.event: The initial Python timeout killed two checker wrappers but left their child checkers orphaned; those already-timed-out children were terminated without touching the unrelated CPU-3 process. Process-group cleanup was added before any future invocation.

independent_checks: all 393 CNFs reconstructed as clause multisets
all 15,360 H11 base-digit assignments truth-table checked against the direct predicate
encoding_theorem.statement: For a fixed base, the emitted CNF is satisfiable iff its frozen fiber contains a Definition-2.1-improper first lift.

outcome: The exact first-lift CNF is unsatisfiable for all 100 frozen stratified p199 base orbits. Therefore none of those 100 bases belongs to F_1(13,199,14). All 293 H11/p47 controls are also certified UNSAT.

p199_finite_result.sample: the exact fixed Cycle-8 10-by-10 stratified completed-base sample
